## GetItems(string) {#Sisk_Core_Entity_StringValueCollection_GetItems_System_String_}

Gets an array of [StringValue](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Entity.StringValue.md) from their key name. If the object was
not found by their name, an empty array of [StringValue](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Entity.StringValue.md) is returned.

public StringValue[] GetItems(string name)
